verses.original: Διώκετε τὴν ἀγάπην ζηλοῦτε δὲ τὰ πνευματικά μᾶλλον δὲ ἵνα προφητεύητε
verses.transliteration: Diōkete tēn agapēn zēloute de ta pneumatika mallon de hina prophēteuēte
verses.literal: Earnestly pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts especially the gift of prophecy

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις λαλεῖ ἀλλὰ Θεῷ οὐδεὶς γὰρ ἀκούει πνεύματι δὲ λαλεῖ μυστήρια
verses.transliteration: ho gar lalōn glōssē ouk anthrōpois lalei alla Theō oudeis gar akouei pneumati de lalei mystēria
verses.literal: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men but to God Indeed no one understands him he utters mysteries in the Spirit

verses.original: ὁ δὲ προφητεύων ἀνθρώποις λαλεῖ οἰκοδομὴν καὶ παράκλησιν καὶ παραμυθίαν
verses.transliteration: ho de prophēteuōn anthrōpois lalei oikodomēn kai paraklēsin kai paramythian
verses.literal: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification encouragement and comfort

verses.original: ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ ἑαυτὸν οἰκοδομεῖ ὁ δὲ προφητεύων ἐκκλησίαν οἰκοδομεῖ
verses.transliteration: ho lalōn glōssē heauton oikodomei ho de prophēteuōn ekklēsian oikodomei
verses.literal: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself but the one who prophesies edifies the church

verses.original: Θέλω δὲ πάντας ὑμᾶς λαλεῖν γλώσσαις μᾶλλον δὲ ἵνα προφητεύητε μείζων δὲ ὁ προφητεύων ἢ ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσαις ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ διερμηνεύῃ ἵνα ἡ ἐκκλησία οἰκοδομὴν λάβῃ
verses.transliteration: Thelō de pantas hymas lalein glōssais mallon de hina prophēteuēte meizōn de ho prophēteuōn ē ho lalōn glōssais ektos ei mē diermēneuē hina hē ekklēsia oikodomēn labē
verses.literal: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues but I would rather have you prophesy He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues unless . . . . . . he interprets so that the church may be edified

verses.original: Νῦν δέ ἀδελφοί ἐὰν ἔλθω πρὸς ὑμᾶς γλώσσαις λαλῶν τί ὑμᾶς ὠφελήσω ἐὰν μὴ ὑμῖν λαλήσω ἢ ἐν ἀποκαλύψει ἢ ἐν γνώσει ἢ ἐν προφητείᾳ ἢ ἐν διδαχῇ
verses.transliteration: Nyn de adelphoi ean elthō pros hymas glōssais lalōn ti hymas ōphelēsō ean mē hymin lalēsō ē en apokalypsei ē en gnōsei ē en prophēteia ē en didachē
verses.literal: Now brothers if I come to you speaking in tongues how will I benefit you unless . . . I bring you - some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching

verses.original: ὅμως τὰ ἄψυχα φωνὴν διδόντα εἴτε αὐλὸς εἴτε κιθάρα ἐὰν διαστολὴν τοῖς φθόγγοις μὴ δῷ πῶς γνωσθήσεται τὸ αὐλούμενον ἢ τὸ κιθαριζόμενον
verses.transliteration: homōs ta apsycha phōnēn didonta eite aulos eite kithara ean diastolēn tois phthongois mē dō pōs gnōsthēsetai to auloumenon ē to kitharizomenon
verses.literal: Even in the case of lifeless instruments . . . such as the flute or harp how will anyone recognize the tune . . . . . . . . . . . . they are playing unless . . . the notes are distinct

verses.original: Καὶ γὰρ ἐὰν ἄδηλον σάλπιγξ φωνὴν δῷ τίς παρασκευάσεται εἰς πόλεμον
verses.transliteration: Kai gar ean adēlon salpinx phōnēn dō tis paraskeuasetai eis polemon
verses.literal: Again . . . if the trumpet sounds a muffled call who will prepare for battle

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς διὰ τῆς γλώσσης ἐὰν μὴ εὔσημον λόγον δῶτε πῶς γνωσθήσεται τὸ λαλούμενον ἔσεσθε γὰρ εἰς ἀέρα λαλοῦντες
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hymeis dia tēs glōssēs ean mē eusēmon logon dōte pōs gnōsthēsetai to laloumenon esesthe gar eis aera lalountes
verses.literal: So it is with you Unless . . . you speak intelligible words with your tongue how will anyone know what you are saying You will just be speaking into the air

verses.original: Τοσαῦτα εἰ τύχοι γένη φωνῶν εἰσιν ἐν κόσμῳ καὶ οὐδὲν ἄφωνον
verses.transliteration: Tosauta ei tychoi genē phōnōn eisin en kosmō kai ouden aphōnon
verses.literal: Assuredly there are many different languages in the world yet none of them is without meaning

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν μὴ εἰδῶ τὴν δύναμιν τῆς φωνῆς ἔσομαι τῷ λαλοῦντι βάρβαρος καὶ ὁ λαλῶν ἐν ἐμοὶ βάρβαρος
verses.transliteration: ean oun mē eidō tēn dynamin tēs phōnēs esomai tō lalounti barbaros kai ho lalōn en emoi barbaros
verses.literal: If then I do not know the meaning of someone’s language I am a foreigner to the speaker and he is a foreigner to me

verses.original: Οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπεὶ ζηλωταί ἐστε πνευμάτων πρὸς τὴν οἰκοδομὴν τῆς ἐκκλησίας ζητεῖτε ἵνα περισσεύητε
verses.transliteration: Houtōs kai hymeis epei zēlōtai este pneumatōn pros tēn oikodomēn tēs ekklēsias zēteite hina perisseuēte
verses.literal: It is the same . . . with you Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts strive . . . to excel in gifts that build up the church

verses.original: Διὸ ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ προσευχέσθω ἵνα διερμηνεύῃ
verses.transliteration: Dio ho lalōn glōssē proseuchesthō hina diermēneuē
verses.literal: Therefore the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret

verses.original: ἐὰν γὰρ προσεύχωμαι γλώσσῃ τὸ πνεῦμά μου προσεύχεται ὁ δὲ νοῦς μου ἄκαρπός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: ean gar proseuchōmai glōssē to pneuma mou proseuchetai ho de nous mou akarpos estin
verses.literal: For if I pray in a tongue my spirit prays but my mind is unfruitful

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐστιν προσεύξομαι τῷ πνεύματι προσεύξομαι δὲ καὶ τῷ νοΐ ψαλῶ τῷ πνεύματι ψαλῶ δὲ καὶ τῷ νοΐ
verses.transliteration: Ti oun estin proseuxomai tō pneumati proseuxomai de kai tō noi psalō tō pneumati psalō de kai tō noi
verses.literal: What then shall I do I will pray with my spirit but I will also pray with my mind I will sing with my spirit but I will also sing with my mind

verses.original: ἐπεὶ ἐὰν εὐλογῇς ἐν πνεύματι ὁ ἀναπληρῶν τὸν τόπον τοῦ ἰδιώτου πῶς ἐρεῖ τὸ Ἀμήν ἐπὶ τῇ σῇ εὐχαριστίᾳ ἐπειδὴ τί λέγεις οὐκ οἶδεν
verses.transliteration: epei ean eulogēs en pneumati ho anaplērōn ton topon tou idiōtou pōs erei to Amēn epi tē sē eucharistia epeidē ti legeis ouk oiden
verses.literal: Otherwise if you speak a blessing in spirit how can someone who is uninstructed say Amen to your thanksgiving since he does not know . . . what you are saying

verses.original: σὺ μὲν γὰρ καλῶς εὐχαριστεῖς ἀλλ’ ὁ ἕτερος οὐκ οἰκοδομεῖται
verses.transliteration: sy men gar kalōs eucharisteis all’ ho heteros ouk oikodomeitai
verses.literal: You may be giving thanks well enough but the other one is not edified

verses.original: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ Θεῷ πάντων ὑμῶν μᾶλλον γλώσσαις λαλῶ
verses.transliteration: Eucharistō tō Theō pantōn hymōn mallon glōssais lalō
verses.literal: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ θέλω πέντε λόγους τῷ νοΐ μου λαλῆσαι ἵνα καὶ ἄλλους κατηχήσω ἢ μυρίους λόγους ἐν γλώσσῃ
verses.transliteration: alla en ekklēsia thelō pente logous tō noi mou lalēsai hina kai allous katēchēsō ē myrious logous en glōssē
verses.literal: But in the church I would rather speak five coherent words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue

verses.original: Ἀδελφοί μὴ παιδία γίνεσθε ταῖς φρεσίν ἀλλὰ τῇ κακίᾳ νηπιάζετε ταῖς δὲ φρεσὶν τέλειοι γίνεσθε
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi mē paidia ginesthe tais phresin alla tē kakia nēpiazete tais de phresin teleioi ginesthe
verses.literal: Brothers stop thinking like children In regard to evil be infants but in your thinking be mature

verses.original: ἐν τῷ νόμῳ γέγραπται ὅτι Ἐν ἑτερογλώσσοις καὶ ἐν χείλεσιν ἑτέρων λαλήσω τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ καὶ οὐδ’ οὕτως εἰσακούσονταί μου λέγει Κύριος
verses.transliteration: en tō nomō gegraptai hoti En heteroglōssois kai en cheilesin heterōn lalēsō tō laō toutō kai oud’ houtōs eisakousontai mou legei Kyrios
verses.literal: It is written in the Law By strange tongues and foreign lips I will speak to this people but even then they will not listen to Me says the Lord

verses.original: Ὥστε αἱ γλῶσσαι εἰς σημεῖόν εἰσιν οὐ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἀλλὰ τοῖς ἀπίστοις ἡ δὲ προφητεία οὐ τοῖς ἀπίστοις ἀλλὰ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν
verses.transliteration: Hōste hai glōssai eis sēmeion eisin ou tois pisteuousin alla tois apistois hē de prophēteia ou tois apistois alla tois pisteuousin
verses.literal: Tongues then are a sign not for believers but for unbelievers - Prophecy however is for believers not for unbelievers

verses.original: Ἐὰν οὖν συνέλθῃ ἡ ἐκκλησία ὅλη ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ πάντες λαλῶσιν γλώσσαις εἰσέλθωσιν δὲ ἰδιῶται ἢ ἄπιστοι οὐκ ἐροῦσιν ὅτι μαίνεσθε
verses.transliteration: Ean oun synelthē hē ekklēsia holē epi to auto kai pantes lalōsin glōssais eiselthōsin de idiōtai ē apistoi ouk erousin hoti mainesthe
verses.literal: So if the whole church comes together . . . . . . and everyone speaks in tongues and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in will they not say that you are out of your minds

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ πάντες προφητεύωσιν εἰσέλθῃ δέ τις ἄπιστος ἢ ἰδιώτης ἐλέγχεται ὑπὸ πάντων ἀνακρίνεται ὑπὸ πάντων
verses.transliteration: ean de pantes prophēteuōsin eiselthē de tis apistos ē idiōtēs elenchetai hypo pantōn anakrinetai hypo pantōn
verses.literal: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying he will be convicted - and called to account by all

verses.original: τὰ κρυπτὰ τῆς καρδίας αὐτοῦ φανερὰ γίνεται καὶ οὕτως πεσὼν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον προσκυνήσει τῷ Θεῷ ἀπαγγέλλων ὅτι Ὄντως ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: ta krypta tēs kardias autou phanera ginetai kai houtōs pesōn epi prosōpon proskynēsei tō Theō apangellōn hoti Ontōs ho Theos en hymin estin
verses.literal: and the secrets of his heart will be made known So . . . he will fall facedown and worship God proclaiming - God is truly among you

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐστιν ἀδελφοί ὅταν συνέρχησθε ἕκαστος ψαλμὸν ἔχει διδαχὴν ἔχει ἀποκάλυψιν ἔχει γλῶσσαν ἔχει ἑρμηνείαν ἔχει πάντα πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν γινέσθω
verses.transliteration: Ti oun estin adelphoi hotan synerchēsthe hekastos psalmon echei didachēn echei apokalypsin echei glōssan echei hermēneian echei panta pros oikodomēn ginesthō
verses.literal: What then shall we say brothers When you come together everyone has a psalm or a teaching a revelation a tongue or an interpretation All of these must be done to build up the church

verses.original: Εἴτε γλώσσῃ τις λαλεῖ κατὰ δύο ἢ τὸ πλεῖστον τρεῖς καὶ ἀνὰ μέρος καὶ εἷς διερμηνευέτω
verses.transliteration: Eite glōssē tis lalei kata dyo ē to pleiston treis kai ana meros kai heis diermēneuetō
verses.literal: If anyone speaks in a tongue two or at most three should speak in turn and someone must interpret

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ᾖ διερμηνευτής σιγάτω ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ ἑαυτῷ δὲ λαλείτω καὶ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: ean de mē ē diermēneutēs sigatō en ekklēsia heautō de laleitō kai tō Theō
verses.literal: But if there is no interpreter he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God

verses.original: Προφῆται δὲ δύο ἢ τρεῖς λαλείτωσαν καὶ οἱ ἄλλοι διακρινέτωσαν
verses.transliteration: Prophētai de dyo ē treis laleitōsan kai hoi alloi diakrinetōsan
verses.literal: Two or three prophets should speak and the others should weigh carefully what is said

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ ἄλλῳ ἀποκαλυφθῇ καθημένῳ ὁ πρῶτος σιγάτω
verses.transliteration: ean de allō apokalyphthē kathēmenō ho prōtos sigatō
verses.literal: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated the first speaker should stop

verses.original: δύνασθε γὰρ καθ’ ἕνα πάντες προφητεύειν ἵνα πάντες μανθάνωσιν καὶ πάντες παρακαλῶνται
verses.transliteration: dynasthe gar kath’ hena pantes prophēteuein hina pantes manthanōsin kai pantes parakalōntai
verses.literal: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged

verses.original: καὶ πνεύματα προφητῶν προφήταις ὑποτάσσεται
verses.transliteration: kai pneumata prophētōn prophētais hypotassetai
verses.literal: The spirits of prophets are subject to prophets

verses.original: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν ἀκαταστασίας ὁ Θεὸς ἀλλὰ εἰρήνης Ὡς ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῶν ἁγίων
verses.transliteration: ou gar estin akatastasias ho Theos alla eirēnēs Hōs en pasais tais ekklēsiais tōn hagiōn
verses.literal: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace as in all the churches of the saints

verses.original: αἱ γυναῖκες ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις σιγάτωσαν οὐ γὰρ ἐπιτρέπεται αὐταῖς λαλεῖν ἀλλὰ ὑποτασσέσθωσαν καθὼς καὶ ὁ νόμος λέγει
verses.transliteration: hai gynaikes en tais ekklēsiais sigatōsan ou gar epitrepetai autais lalein alla hypotassesthōsan kathōs kai ho nomos legei
verses.literal: Women are to be silent in the churches They are not permitted to speak but must be in submission as the law says

verses.original: εἰ δέ τι μαθεῖν θέλουσιν ἐν οἴκῳ τοὺς ἰδίους ἄνδρας ἐπερωτάτωσαν αἰσχρὸν γάρ ἐστιν γυναικὶ λαλεῖν ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: ei de ti mathein thelousin en oikō tous idious andras eperōtatōsan aischron gar estin gynaiki lalein en ekklēsia
verses.literal: If they wish to inquire about something they are to ask their own husbands at home for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church

verses.original: Ἢ ἀφ’ ὑμῶν ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐξῆλθεν ἢ εἰς ὑμᾶς μόνους κατήντησεν
verses.transliteration: Ē aph’ hymōn ho logos tou Theou exēlthen ē eis hymas monous katēntēsen
verses.literal: Did the word of God originate with you Or are you the only ones it has reached

verses.original: Εἴ τις δοκεῖ προφήτης εἶναι ἢ πνευματικός ἐπιγινωσκέτω ἃ γράφω ὑμῖν ὅτι Κυρίου ἐστὶν ἐντολή
verses.transliteration: Ei tis dokei prophētēs einai ē pneumatikos epiginōsketō ha graphō hymin hoti Kyriou estin entolē
verses.literal: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command

verses.original: εἰ δέ τις ἀγνοεῖ ἀγνοεῖται
verses.transliteration: ei de tis agnoei agnoeitai
verses.literal: But if anyone ignores this he himself will be ignored

verses.original: Ὥστε ἀδελφοί μου ζηλοῦτε τὸ προφητεύειν καὶ τὸ λαλεῖν μὴ κωλύετε γλώσσαις
verses.transliteration: Hōste adelphoi mou zēloute to prophēteuein kai to lalein mē kōlyete glōssais
verses.literal: So my brothers be eager to prophesy and do not forbid speaking in tongues

verses.original: πάντα δὲ εὐσχημόνως καὶ κατὰ τάξιν γινέσθω
verses.transliteration: panta de euschēmonōs kai kata taxin ginesthō
verses.literal: But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner
